facts.fact: Kabata (2024) says Kenya has no stand-alone digital identity law: the National Integrated Identity Management System rests on executive order no. 1 of 2018, was written into the 1947 Registration of Persons Act as section 9A by an omnibus amendment, and is anchored on the Huduma Namba regulations of 2020; the High Court ruled in January 2020 that a comprehensive framework should be enacted before rollout. Read, on Bill's ruling of 2026-10-12, as a system run on an order with no identity law behind it.
